scope: Local PGlite, real worker HTTP and browser SSE, controlled OpenAI-compatible SSE stub. No real model A/B. Backlog counters overlap between concurrent runs. SQL writes count submitted statements, not WAL bytes; tokens are stub values. Memory is a process snapshot, not a peak or tenant attribution.

Sort Key: (((CASE work.lane WHEN 'interactive'::text THEN 4 WHEN 'approval'::text THEN 3 WHEN 'collaboration'::text THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)::numeric + floor((GREATEST('0'::numeric, EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - work.available_at))) / '60'::numeric)))) DESC

Plans.Filter: ((prerequisite.status <> 'succeeded'::text) OR (prerequisite.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL) OR (result.id IS NULL) OR (result.request_version <> (jsonb_array_length(prerequisite.steer_inputs) + 1)) OR ((((result.message -> 'envelope'::text) -> 'goalOutcome'::text) ->> 'status'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'satisfied'::text))

((cancel_requested_at IS NULL) AND (kind = ANY ('{resume,turn}'::text[])) AND ((kind <> ALL ('{memory_synthesis,memory_index,memory_evaluation}'::text[])) OR (attempts < 3)) AND ((status = 'queued'::text) OR ((status = 'leased'::text) AND (lease_expires_at <= now()))) AND (NOT EXISTS(SubPlan 1)))
((NOT (principal_id IS DISTINCT FROM work.principal_id)) AND (tenant_id = work.tenant_id))
